suggestions.headline: Let the garlic rest before it hits the oil
suggestions.body: Crush the garlic first and leave it on the board for ten minutes while you shape the patties. Nothing else about the recipe changes.

suggestions.headline: The lemon is doing more than seasoning
suggestions.body: Lemon juice and tomato sit in the same meal as the chickpeas, which is what helps you absorb the iron in them. Keep them in.

suggestions.headline: Save the tea for later
suggestions.body: Tea and coffee alongside this meal bind some of the iron. An hour either side is enough.
